purpose.summary: Prepare an independent SHA-256d Ergon development testnet with mainnet-faithful monetary rules and explicit optional upstream Chronik admission.
scope: Exact successor of accepted public 1029eb3/tree e03012d; no incoming reports, binaries, operator data or private history.
Separate genesis, magic, addresses, storage, ports and explicit -ergontestnet selection; inherited test/test4/main are never fallback peers or identities.

Preserve mainnet SHA-256d, EMA algorithm, 600-second spacing, 144-block decay, value calibration and integer rounding; easier bootstrap and pow limit and current-rules-from-origin are explicit test-only differences.
No reward floor, emission cap, automatic minimum difficulty exception or CPU-exclusive rule; optional extreme experiments do not determine consensus parameters.
tXRG/eight-decimal display metadata on the dedicated network only; numeric RPC amounts and mainnet output shape remain unchanged.
Existing upstream indexer, token engines and plugin loader admitted only with exact native network and genesis; still default-OFF, observe/index-only, loopback service and separate roots.
Bounded exact compact-target reward threshold vectors, moderate native DAA vectors and five actual accepted SHA-256d blocks through isolated two-node P2P, restart and optional Chronik indexing.

New exact successor manifest freezes every other accepted input; immutable predecessor source gates rerun on their accepted public tree; inherited runtime bodies, assertions, repetitions and deadlines remain on the current binary.

Inherited runtime entrypoints and the final CI source recheck import the current exact testnet successor gate; their execution bodies and oracles remain byte-identical apart from that import. The cold-rebuild synthetic test mocks the same current gate.
Five Linux profiles retain their existing coverage; add independent network and foreign-active-chain identity controls without dependency registry changes.
exclusions: No mainnet rule, activation, genesis, checkpoint, reward, DAA, seed or service change; no testnet CashTokens activation or DAA redesign.
No automatic mining, wallet/desktop integration, mainnet bridge, implicit cross-network swap, universal signature replay protection claim, deployment by CI or proof promotion.
No private source/history, operator identity, endpoint, configuration, datadir, traffic, secret, raw report, build output or binary.

platforms: ubuntu-24.04; public Rust registry inputs locked, system packages and runner image unlocked

limitations: This source record is not a public execution report, deployment or production-readiness claim.
Bootstrap has zero subsidy; low-rate mining may advance the chain without spendable emission. No funded-flow claim follows from five zero-value blocks.
Current rules start at the new chain origin; monetary age and pre-EMA history differ from mainnet. Easier pow limit is explicit, not mainnet-equivalent at every target.
No hardware qualification, miner economics, DAA convergence or guaranteed withdrawal recovery. No universal signature replay protection or completed GUI/wallet integration.
Existing upstream dependency alerts and historical timeouts remain open; no current success erases them.
counterevidence: The initial public CI on 69c151a built and passed the new native testnet suites and real five-block/P2P/restart smoke but later inherited entrypoints and final recheck still called the predecessor source gate, which correctly refused the new source tree. Those red CI results remain counterevidence; the correction selects the exact current gate without removing runtime cases, changing assertions or increasing deadlines.
A preparation-only accelerated monetary profile was superseded by the mainnet-fidelity requirement; its build is not evidence for this profile.
Preparation found a C++ target type mismatch in a new test; compilation failure is not a passing native result.

An initial two-node preparation run stopped during RPC warmup; it is not a passing accepted-block observation. Retry is limited to expected RPC warmup and network-selection refusals must exit normally, not by signal.

A later preparation mined five native blocks but did not propagate them: the fixture's maxconnections=4 left no inbound slots after native outbound/feeler reservations. The fixture now allows16 and requires completed version exchange plus ping/pong before mining; the native P2P admission policy is unchanged.
Ideal rate-times-spacing arithmetic differs from compact-quantized work near the zero/one boundary; exact adjacent targets are required.
Previous inherited timeout counterevidence is preserved in unchanged accepted records; none is deleted or promoted by this successor.
